name: Haures Clifford
original_name: ハウレス・クリフォード
source:
The leader of the young butlers, he carries a high sense of responsibility with a strikingly perfectionist personality. He closely observes his surroundings, as he closes himself off to them… The work he produces as a butler is perfect but his ability to live in his private life is lacking, as he is unable to clean or cook.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/640029665045643264/character-introduction-pv-haures-clifford]official character PV[/url]]
